apps.description: The apps to upgrade. Each entry needs appName; owner/repo/appPath/branch are optional overrides (coordinates otherwise resolve through the registry -> convention waterfall). Duplicates are skipped. Omit when using fromScan.

appPath.description: Path to the app module inside the repo (monorepo).

deployedApiName.description: Exact Runtime Manager name for the live deployed-state check.

fromScan.description: Instead of `apps`, take the fleet-scan candidate list. Candidates the scan could not map to a GitHub repo are reported SKIPPED, never guessed at.

environment.description: ONE Anypoint environment for the whole batch. Concurrency is across apps, not environments.

environments.description: Environments to scan when fromScan is true (defaults to [environment]).

mode.description: Repo access mode for every app in the batch (default api).

confirm.description: REQUIRED to write anything. Without it the batch previews every app and returns PLAN_PREVIEW — a 20-app run can never open 20 PRs by accident. Ask the user explicitly before setting true.

concurrency.description: Apps in flight at once (default config batch.concurrency, 3). Each app is I/O-bound on GitHub + Exchange; raising this trades rate-limit risk for wall time.

stopOnFailure.description: Do not start further apps once one fails (default false — a batch normally reports every app's outcome).

includeParentPomRouted.description: Execute apps whose connector gaps are managed in a shared parent/BOM pom (default false). Leave false when several apps share ONE pom: they must be fixed by upgrading that pom once via a chained flow, not by N parallel edits that would contend on the same parent-pom lock.

versionStrategy.description: Connector version strategy applied to every app (default min = the curated matrix pins).

connectorSelections.description: For versionStrategy "manual": { "<artifactId>": "<version>" }. Applied to every app in the batch.

jiraTicketId.description: One Jira ticket for the whole batch (used when notifyPrefs.jira is "comment").

notifyPrefs.description: Opt-in Slack/Jira preferences applied to EVERY app in the batch. Omitted → silent: configured credentials are capability, not consent.

slack.description: Post Slack lifecycle alerts for each app's job (default false).

jira.description: none (default) = never touch Jira; comment = comment on jiraTicketId; create = open a ticket per app, then comment on it.
